local function createNexusIcon(parent, role, options)
	options = options or {}
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = options.name or (role .. "Icon")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.size or 32, options.size or 32)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.Parent = holder

	local padding = math.clamp(options.padding or 12, 0, 25) / 100

	local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	canvas.Name = "Glyph"
	canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(padding, padding)
	canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - padding * 2, 1 - padding * 2)
	canvas.Parent = holder

	local color = options.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	local function shape(x, y, w, h, rotation, round)
		local part = Instance.new("Frame")
		part.Name = "GlyphPart"
		part.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		part.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
		part.Rotation = rotation or 0
		part.BackgroundColor3 = color
		part.BorderSizePixel = 0
		part.Parent = canvas
		if round then
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
			corner.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end

	local function bar(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		return shape((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), width or 0.14, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), 0.5)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, radius, width)
		for index = 0, 11 do
			local a, b = index * math.pi / 6, (index + 1) * math.pi / 6
			bar(x + math.cos(a) * radius, y + math.sin(a) * radius, x + math.cos(b) * radius, y + math.sin(b) * radius, width or 0.12)
		end
	end

	if role == "play" then
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local x = index / 16
			shape(0.22 + x * 0.58, 0.5, 0.58 / 16 + 0.005, 0.76 * (1 - x), 0, nil)
		end
	elseif role == "close" or role == "plus" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and 45 or 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and -45 or 90, 0.5)
	elseif role == "settings" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.16)
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			shape(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.33, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.33, 0.26, 0.16, math.deg(angle), 0.3)
		end
	else
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.39, 0.11)
		shape(0.5, 0.31, 0.14, 0.14, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.62, 0.14, 0.3, 0, 0.4)
	end

	return holder
end

local function applyNativeShadow(parent, name, zIndex, transparency)
	local ok, shadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok and shadow then
		shadow.Name = name or "Shadow"
		shadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		shadow.Transparency = transparency or 0.72
		shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
		shadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6)
		shadow.Parent = parent
		parent.ZIndex = zIndex or parent.ZIndex
		return shadow
	end
	return nil
end

	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
	shadow.ZIndex = math.max(1, label.ZIndex - 1)
	shadow.Text = label.Text

	shadow.TextTransparency = 0.35
	shadow.TextScaled = label.TextScaled
	shadow.TextSize = label.TextSize
	shadow.FontFace = label.FontFace
	shadow.TextWrapped = label.TextWrapped
	shadow.TextXAlignment = label.TextXAlignment
	shadow.TextYAlignment = label.TextYAlignment

	return shadow
end

local function registerFeedback(button)
	if feedbackControllers[button] then
		return
	end

	local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
	local shadow = button:FindFirstChild("Shadow")
	local ok, controller = pcall(function()
		return ButtonEffects.bind(button, {
			visual = visual,
			shadow = shadow,
			hoverScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 1.03 or 1.025,
			pressScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 0.97 or 0.965,
			duration = 0.12,
			sounds = false,
			hoverEnabled = true,
			animations = true,
		})
	end)
	if ok and controller then
		feedbackControllers[button] = controller
	end
end

local function descendantsByName(name)
	local list = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			table.insert(list, descendant)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function firstDescendantOf(instance, name)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			return descendant
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function tween(instance, info, goal)
	local t = TweenService:Create(instance, info, goal)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

local openInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local closeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local activeModalName = nil

local function getVisibleGroup()
	local desktop = firstDescendantOf(root, "_NexusDesktop")
	local mobile = firstDescendantOf(root, "_NexusMobile")
	if mobile and mobile.Visible then
		return mobile
	end
	return desktop
end

local function setBackdropVisible(group, visible)
	if not group then
		return
	end
	local backdrop = firstDescendantOf(group, "ModalBackdrop")
	if not backdrop then
		return
	end
	if visible then
		backdrop.Visible = true
		backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tween(backdrop, fadeInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.42 })
	else
		local t = tween(backdrop, closeInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		connect(t.Completed, function()
			if activeModalName == nil then
				backdrop.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function openModal(name)
	local group = getVisibleGroup()
	if not group then
		return
	end

	for _, modalName in ipairs({ "SettingsModalHost", "CreditsModalHost" }) do
		local host = firstDescendantOf(group, modalName)
		if host then
			if modalName == name then
				host.Visible = true
				host.GroupTransparency = nil
				local scale = host:FindFirstChild("OpenScale")
				if scale then
					scale.Scale = GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled and 1 or 0.96
					tween(scale, openInfo, { Scale = 1 })
				end
				host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				tween(host, fadeInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			else
				host.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	activeModalName = name
	setBackdropVisible(group, true)
end

local function closeModal(name)
	local group = getVisibleGroup()
	if not group then
		return
	end

	local host = firstDescendantOf(group, name)
	if not host then
		return
	end

	local scale = host:FindFirstChild("OpenScale")
	if scale and not GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		tween(scale, closeInfo, { Scale = 0.97 })
	end

	local done = tween(host, closeInfo, {})
	connect(done.Completed, function()
		host.Visible = false
	end)

	if activeModalName == name then
		activeModalName = nil
		setBackdropVisible(group, false)
	end
end

local function closeAllModals()
	for _, groupName in ipairs({ "_NexusDesktop", "_NexusMobile" }) do
		for _, descendant in ipairs(descendantsByName(groupName)) do
			local backdrop = firstDescendantOf(descendant, "ModalBackdrop")
			if backdrop then
				backdrop.Visible = false
				backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			local settings = firstDescendantOf(descendant, "SettingsModalHost")
			if settings then
				settings.Visible = false
			end
			local credits = firstDescendantOf(descendant, "CreditsModalHost")
			if credits then
				credits.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
	activeModalName = nil
end

local function updateToggle(toggle)
	local state = toggle:FindFirstChild("State")
	local visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	if not state or not visual then
		return
	end
	local onNode = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOn")
	local offNode = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOff")
	if onNode then
		onNode.Visible = state.Value
	end
	if offNode then
		offNode.Visible = not state.Value
	end
end

local function setSliderValue(slider, alpha)
	alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
	local valueObject = slider:FindFirstChild("Value")
	if valueObject then
		valueObject.Value = alpha
	end

	local clip = slider:FindFirstChild("TrackFillClip")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if clip then
		clip.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, clip.Size.Y.Scale, clip.Size.Y.Offset)
	end
	if handle then
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end

	local volumeRow = slider.Parent
	if volumeRow then
		local volumeValue = volumeRow:FindFirstChild("VolumeValue")
		if volumeValue and volumeValue:IsA("TextLabel") then
			volumeValue.Text = tostring(math.floor(alpha * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
		end
	end
end

local function sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, inputPositionX)
	local absolutePosition = slider.AbsolutePosition
	local absoluteSize = slider.AbsoluteSize
	if absoluteSize.X <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp((inputPositionX - absolutePosition.X) / absoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
end

for _, slider in ipairs(descendantsByName("VolumeSlider")) do
	local valueObject = slider:FindFirstChild("Value")
	if valueObject then
		setSliderValue(slider, valueObject.Value)
	end

	local hitArea = slider:FindFirstChild("HitArea")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	local function beginDrag(x)
		dragging = slider
		setSliderValue(slider, sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, x))
	end

	if hitArea and hitArea:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(hitArea.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				beginDrag(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
	end

	if handle and handle:IsA("GuiButton") then
		registerFeedback(handle)
		connect(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				beginDrag(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
	end
end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		setSliderValue(dragging, sliderAlphaFromInput(dragging, input.Position.X))
	end
end)

	end
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback

designPlan.artDirection: Premium fantasy-tech main menu centered on a glossy title plate and a single dominant Play call-to-action, using a controlled cyan-to-cobalt palette with thick navy framing and restrained gold edge highlights. Artwork should feel polished and dimensional without clutter: Gemini-generated 9-slice skins for primary buttons and panels, matching ornamental corner pieces used sparingly, and a clean native darkened background field so the interface reads immediately. Text remains fully live, bright, and crisp over painted surfaces. The Settings panel uses the same ornate family but in a practical layout with a readable music toggle row and a distinct volume slider track/handle set. The Credits panel is smaller and quieter, visually subordinate to the main menu. Overall mood is premium, glossy, readable, and game-ready rather than overloaded.

composition.focalPoint: A centered vertical stack led by the AURORA title plate above an unmistakably largest Play button, with Settings and Credits grouped directly beneath in the same dock. Modal panels open above the menu at center, with Settings larger and Credits compact. Decorative corners frame the composition lightly without filling the screen center.
composition.alignmentSystem: Symmetrical centered composition on desktop with a strong vertical axis; mobile reflows to a bottom-weighted centered stack to preserve thumb reach while keeping the title plate above. Comparable menu actions remain in one coherent vertical dock. Modal internals use left-aligned content rows inside centered framed windows. Consistent inset padding, mirrored ornament placement, and even button widths maintain order.

visualSystem.colorRationale: Cyan and cobalt drive the glossy fantasy-tech identity, navy provides structure and thick readable edges, and warm gold is reserved for highlights, trim, and active emphasis so it feels premium rather than noisy. Dark neutral background keeps the menu legible and prevents decorative art from overpowering the action hierarchy. Panels and controls reuse the same surface family to stay coherent.
visualSystem.outlineStyle: Thick navy outer strokes on painted controls and panels, with selective inner gold highlight lines on title plate and primary button. Native text itself is not outlined heavily; emphasis comes from contrast, weight, and controlled shadow. Use UIStroke for native supporting frames where artwork is absent.
visualSystem.shadowStyle: Short stacked shadows with dark navy bias: a soft global drop shadow under panels and title plate, plus a tighter contact shadow under buttons to reinforce press depth. Keep shadow blur moderate and opacity controlled to preserve readability on mobile.

responsiveStrategy.tablet: Use the mobile group for narrow tablet portrait and desktop-like spacing when width allows, but preserve the same canonical node names. Increase panel width modestly, keep the hero stack centered, and avoid over-expanding button widths beyond comfortable scan length.
